evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency.
